source.title: Implementation Guidance for Maintainers
source.applicability: Implementation guidance against Open Source Security Baseline (OSPS), covering secure coding practices, dependency management workflows, and risk treatment decisions for open source project maintainers.

passages.text: Several tools are available to help you automate the process. LFX Insights provides automated measurement and reporting of a variety of project metrics, including Baseline controls.
